Bill.BriefDescription: Providing certain public notices in a language other than English.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing public notices of public health,safety, and welfare in a language other than English; and adding a newsection to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) State agencies required by law or rule to provide publicnotices to a community or area to advise or inform the public about animminent or emergent public health, safety, or welfare risk shallprovide bilingual or multilingual notices when a significant segment ofresidents speak a language other than English and have a limitedproficiency in English. This requirement applies to notices thatinclude, but are not limited to, proposed locations for criminalfacilities or facilities that would house sex offenders. Thisrequirement does not apply to the adoption of rules under chapter 34.05RCW. (2) "Significant segment," for purposes of this section, means fivepercent or more of the residents residing in the affected city, town,or county who are of limited English proficiency. p. 1 SHB 1675 (3) Agencies shall implement the provisions of this section withinexisting funds.
